full_page.content:
1931 August 16
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten orig- inal by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
ST. BONAVENTURE'S MONASTERY 1740 Mt. Elliott Avenue Detroit, Mich.
Aug 16 1931
11 a.m. St. Joachim
Rev. Fr. M. E. Joachim Casey, O.M. Cap. Yonkers, N. Y.
My Dear Brother: -
Just a line while I have time to gratulate you and wish you every blessing. Mary Casey just phoned - is coming out this p.m. to have a little visit, before going back to-night to camp. ... Her mother Emma scalded herself recently rather badly and James Jr. had an operation oo his lez. .... otherwise things seem about as usual on the Coast.
I wrote Pr. Edward a few days ago - have not had word from him in a long time. I know he has very little time for himself - what quite pleases him, I think. .... God bless you now and all my old friends in "City of fine Schools, Villas & Terraces"
, in Corde SSm.
Fr Solanus, O. M. Cap.
